top_signals.title: CISA orders feds to patch exploited Citrix flaws by Wednesday
top_signals.summary: The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has ordered U.S. government agencies over the weekend to secure their systems against attacks exploiting two critical Citrix NetScaler vulnerabilities. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
